title: Misleading question in objective 3 about updating AAPS
body:
When completing objective 3, one of exam questions is [about updating AAPS](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/blob/937e2bccc9c43c1a1566a8ec2793bcae4ff11dba/plugins/constraints/src/main/kotlin/app/aaps/plugins/constraints/objectives/objectives/Objective2.kt#L184)

----
**Actual behavior**
There are 4 possible answers:
1. You need to have Git installed and configured on your computer.
2. When updated versions of AAPS are released, the earlier versions may be remotely limited after a specified time.
3. You should save and note the location of your keystore and use the same signing key for updates as for your previous installation.
4. If you have difficulty building the apk, you can install an apk that has been built by a friend.

Option 1 is one of the correct answers.

----
**Expected bahavior**

Option 1 is an incorrect answer.

One of the ways to build apk is [browser build](https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/SettingUpAaps/BrowserBuild.html). I believe it does not require to install anything except internet browser on your computer. You have to interact with Github (get an account there), but Github is not the same as Git and creating a Github account or making a Github fork is hardly "installing Github".
